tools.name: get_my_user
tools.title: Get My Discord User
tools.description: Get the Discord user profile of the connected account, including id, username, global display name, avatar, and locale.

tools.name: list_my_guilds
tools.title: List My Discord Servers
tools.description: List the Discord servers (guilds) the connected user belongs to, with the user's permissions in each. Use this to find a guild id before calling other guild tools.

after.description: Return guilds after this guild id.

before.description: Return guilds before this guild id.

limit.description: Maximum number of guilds to return. Defaults to 200.

with_counts.description: When true, include approximate member and presence counts for each guild.
